title: CTR +2.1% while clicks per user are flat and queries per user fell 0.5%

reviewer_expected.why: fewer queries per user explains at most +0.5% of a +2.1% CTR rise; the counts and the ratio are on different populations, so the decomposition doesn't close

note: attractive results is a fair candidate for CTR up with long clicks flat; the population mismatch is listed as an open question
